title.zh: OpenPayd在计划纳斯达克上市前获得美国43个州的货币传输许可证 - Pulse 2.0
title.en: OpenPayd Acquires 43 U.S. State Money Transmitter Licenses Ahead Of Planned Nasdaq Listing - Pulse 2.0

current_state.zh: OpenPayd 已获得美国 43 个州的货币传输牌照，并预计与 Titan Acquisition Corp. 的 SPAC 合并将于年底前完成，以代码 OP 在纳斯达克上市，预估股权价值最高 11 亿美元，交易尚待 SEC 及股东批准。
current_state.en: OpenPayd has obtained money transmitter licenses in 43 U.S. states and expects its SPAC merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under ticker OP with a pro forma equity value up to $1.1 billion, pending SEC and shareholder approvals.

updates.title_zh: 【OpenPayd 拟于年底在纳斯达克上市，估值最高 11 亿美元】
updates.title_en: 【OpenPayd 拟于年底在纳斯达克上市，估值最高 11 亿美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenPayd 预计与 Titan Acquisition Corp. 的合并将于年底前完成，以代码 OP 在纳斯达克上市，预估股权价值最高达 11 亿美元，交易尚待 SEC 注册文件生效及 Titan 股东批准；计划在 2027 年 4 月前在美国推出服务。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenPayd expects its merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under ticker OP at a pro forma equity value up to $1.1 billion, pending SEC registration effectiveness and Titan shareholder approval; plans to launch US services by April 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenPayd 已获得美国 43 个州的货币传输牌照，并预计与 Titan Acquisition Corp. 的 SPAC 合并将于年底前完成，以代码 OP 在纳斯达克上市，预估股权价值最高 11 亿美元，交易尚待 SEC 及股东批准。
updates.current_state_en: OpenPayd has obtained money transmitter licenses in 43 U.S. states and expects its SPAC merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under ticker OP with a pro forma equity value up to $1.1 billion, pending SEC and shareholder approvals.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Stablecoin payment infrastructure platform OpenPayd expects its merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under the ticker OP at a pro forma equity value of up to $1.1 billion, with proceeds aimed at US expansion, licensing and acquisitions.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Stablecoin payment infrastructure platform OpenPayd expects its merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under the ticker OP at a pro forma equity value of up to $1.1 billion, with proceeds aimed at US expansion, licensing and acquisitions.
updates.background_zh: SPAC（特殊目的收购公司）通过 IPO 募集资金，随后与实体目标公司合并，这条路径的完成速度通常快于传统 IPO。OpenPayd 处于稳定币支付基础设施领域，为企业提供合规的资金收发与结算通道。
updates.background_en: A SPAC, or special-purpose acquisition company, raises capital through an IPO and then merges with an operating target, a route that can close faster than a traditional IPO. OpenPayd operates in the stablecoin payments infrastructure segment, providing regulated rails for businesses to send, receive and settle funds.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一上市路径指向加密市场中的稳定币与支付基础设施板块：稳定币支付服务商获得纳斯达克上市载体，可能使公开股票市场对相关板块的敞口从代币扩展到股权，但交易完成仍取决于 SEC 注册生效与股东批准。
updates.market_impact_en: The listing path touches the stablecoin and payments-infrastructure segment of crypto markets: a public Nasdaq vehicle for a stablecoin payments provider could broaden listed-market exposure to the sector through equity rather than tokens, while the deal's completion remains contingent on SEC effectiveness and shareholder approval.
